description: Feature vector definition for the pseudonymised real-attacker actor set. The names are the exact keys produced by the project's feature extractor; the values are the extracted numeric values.

F1.description: Semantic causality: does the next action depend on the previous response?

F3.description: Feedback adaptivity: does the actor change route after an error response?

F4.description: Rhythm: machine burst speed combined with human-scale thinking pauses.

F5.description: Exploration structure: breadth, depth, entropy, error tolerance, discovery rate.

F6.description: Repetition and verification: enumeration intensity, retry breadth, back-tracking.

F7.description: Identity lineage: identity count, unauthenticated share, identity churn, role.

F8.description: Egress intelligence: outbound destinations observed during the attack window.

F9.description: Tool fingerprint: user-agent families and switching (context only, not a main-score input).

F10.description: Machine-generated account naming: structural regularity of registered account names.

F11.description: Payload semantics: maliciousness axis, orthogonal to the AI axis.

F13.description: Configuration-probe axis: share of configuration/management paths and API paths.

f1_identity_switches.description: Number of consecutive request pairs whose authenticated identity differs.

f1_identity_switch_rate.description: Identity switches divided by the number of requests.

f1_real_switches.description: Identity switches between two authenticated (non-anonymous) identities.

f1_response_capture.description: 1 when response headers or response bodies were captured, 0 otherwise (0 in this release).

f1_token_carry_hits.description: Requests that carry a token issued in a previous response (0 when no response capture).

f1_token_carry_ratio.description: Token-carrying requests divided by the number of responses examined.

f1_hint_follow_hits.description: Requests that follow a path hint taken from a previous response body.

f3_err_count.description: Number of requests answered with a 4xx or 5xx status.

f3_err_new_family.description: Share of error responses that are followed by a request in a different endpoint family.

f3_err_new_template.description: Share of error responses that are followed by a request on a different path template.

f3_err_same_template.description: Share of error responses that are followed by a request on the same path template.

f3_err_to_2xx_k3.description: Share of error responses within three requests of a 2xx response.

f3_distinct_err_families.description: Number of distinct endpoint families that produced an error response.

f3_family_prune.description: Share of repeatedly failing endpoint families that are effectively abandoned afterwards.

f3_404_tolerance.description: Share of 404 responses after which the actor keeps sending requests.

f3_403_tolerance.description: Share of 403 responses after which the actor keeps sending requests.

f4_req_count.description: Number of requests in the actor window.

f4_gap_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of the inter-request gaps.

f4_zero_gap_ratio.description: Share of inter-request gaps that are zero or negative (concurrent bursts).

f4_bimodality.description: Bimodality coefficient of the log10 gap distribution.

f4_burst_max_1s.description: Largest number of requests issued inside a one-second window.

f4_burst_max_10s.description: Largest number of requests issued inside a ten-second window.

f4_burst_ratio.description: Share of gaps of one second or less.

f4_think_ratio.description: Share of gaps longer than one second.

f4_think_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of the gaps longer than one second.

f4_think_median.description: Median of the gaps longer than one second, in seconds.

f4_think_max.description: Longest gap longer than one second, in seconds.

f4_machine_speed.description: Alias of f4_burst_ratio (machine-speed component of the compound feature).

f4_machine_x_think.description: Product of f4_burst_ratio and f4_think_ratio (machine speed times human-scale thinking).

f4_gap_log_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the rounded log10 gap distribution.

f5_distinct_templates.description: Number of distinct normalised path templates.

f5_template_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the path-template distribution.

f5_family_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the endpoint-family distribution.

f5_depth_max.description: Maximum number of path segments in any requested path.

f5_status_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the status-class distribution.

f5_404_ratio.description: Share of requests answered with a 4xx status.

f5_5xx_ratio.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status.

f5_2xx_ratio.description: Share of requests answered with a 2xx status.

f5_duration_s.description: Elapsed time between the first and the last request of the window, in seconds.

f5_rpm.description: Requests per minute over the window.

f5_static_ratio.description: Share of requests targeting static-asset extensions.

f5_discovery_rate.description: Distinct path templates per hundred requests.

f5_method_count.description: Number of distinct HTTP methods used.

f5_body_ratio.description: Share of requests that carry a request body.

f5_arg_ratio.description: Share of requests that carry a query string.

f6_retry_templates.description: Number of path templates requested more than once.

f6_retry_ratio.description: Share of path templates requested more than once.

f6_repeat_request_ratio.description: Share of requests that are repeats of an already seen path template.

f6_enum_max_ids.description: Largest number of distinct numeric identifiers seen under a single path template.

f6_enum_templates.description: Number of path templates under which more than one numeric identifier was tried.

f6_verify_backtrack.description: Share of 2xx responses that are followed within seven requests by a repeat of the same template.

f6_arg_variant_max.description: Largest number of distinct query strings seen under a single path template.

f6_top_repeat.description: Largest number of requests issued against a single path template.

f7_distinct_users.description: Number of distinct authenticated identities used in the window.

f7_unauth_ratio.description: Share of requests with no authenticated identity.

f7_identity_churn.description: Distinct identities per minute of activity.

f7_first_auth_latency.description: Index of the first authenticated request (window length when never authenticated).

f7_never_auth.description: 1 when the actor never authenticates, 0 otherwise.

f7_admin_role_ratio.description: Share of observed roles whose name contains an administrative marker.

f8_egress_total.description: Total number of outbound attempts recorded in the window (0 in this release: no egress log).

f8_egress_distinct.description: Number of distinct outbound destinations (0 in this release).

f8_egress_codehost.description: Outbound attempts to code-hosting domains (0 in this release).

f8_egress_cdn.description: Outbound attempts to CDN domains (0 in this release).

f8_egress_llm_api.description: Outbound attempts to language-model API endpoints (0 in this release).

f8_egress_metadata.description: Outbound attempts to the cloud metadata address (0 in this release).

f8_egress_per_min.description: Outbound attempts inside the request window per minute (0 in this release).

f8_egress_in_window.description: Outbound attempts within 60 seconds of a request in the window (0 in this release).

f9_ua_families.description: Number of distinct user-agent families used.

f9_ua_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the user-agent family distribution.

f9_ua_switches.description: Number of consecutive request pairs whose user-agent family differs.

f9_ua_switch_rate.description: User-agent family switches divided by the number of requests.

f9_has_browser.description: 1 when a browser-like user agent is present.

f9_has_scanner.description: 1 when a scanner-like user agent is present.

f9_noncurl_ratio.description: Share of requests that do not use the curl user agent.

f9_ua_block_ratio.description: Ratio of distinct user-agent families minus one to the number of distinct families.

f10_user_count.description: Number of distinct registered account names observed.

f10_machine_named_ratio.description: Share of account names whose local part follows a machine-generated structure.

f10_ts_suffix_ratio.description: Share of account names whose local part ends with a 10 to 13 digit timestamp.

f10_dot_label_ratio.description: Share of account names whose local part contains at least two dot-separated labels.

f10_label_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the dot-separated label distribution of account names.

f10_seq_suffix_ratio.description: Share of account names whose local part ends with a one to three digit sequence.

f11_payload_total.description: Total number of matched attack-payload patterns across all requests.

f11_payload_kinds.description: Number of distinct attack-payload pattern classes matched.

f13_config_ratio.description: Share of requests targeting configuration, credential or management paths.

f13_api_ratio.description: Share of requests targeting paths that contain an API segment.
